name: Memphis Milano
summary: 80s Memphis Milano maximalism: laminate slabs, squiggles and terrazzo, where a friendly squiggle snaps into a coral zigzag.
look: Warm paper and soft-teal dot grids, laminate patterns (bacterio, diagonal stripes), terrazzo confetti, tilted blocks with hard black shadows. Teal, coral, amber and blush, with chunky Manrope 800 type.

components.name: Laminate slab
components.role: tilted card with pattern fill and a 14 px hard ink shadow

components.name: Bacterio pattern
components.role: scattered black squiggle marks on paper, 80 px tile

components.name: Totem
components.role: stacked geometric solids crowned by the Acme mark

components.name: Terrazzo confetti
components.role: random coloured flecks as background texture

components.name: Shadow pill
components.role: rounded CTA with 6 px outline and offset solid shadow

motion.name: Drop & tilt
motion.how: slabs fall from −200 px with rotation, bounce.out 0.4 s, one per 8th note (0.25 s)

motion.name: Squiggle wiggle
motion.how: path phase shifts half a wavelength per beat, stepped — reads like a bassline

motion.name: Snap to zigzag
motion.how: squiggle morphs to zigzag in 0.12 s (3 frames) exactly on a downbeat, with a 4-frame colour flash

story: Hook: a pile of tilted laminate dashboard slabs under "How many dashboards did you check today?". Reveal: a Memphis totem assembles with the Acme mark on top, "Acme Pulse". Proof: on a laminate-framed chart the teal squiggle snaps into a coral zigzag at deploy #2231 · 09:42, a triangle tag says −18% checkout conversion, a human presses the Roll back pill. CTA: "Caught before customers noticed." with an amber Start free pill on terrazzo.
adapt: Turn your product's core objects (projects, tickets, files) into laminate slabs and let your 'normal' visual be a squiggle that your product protects. Swap the totem pieces for shapes that echo your own logo.

references.note: Memphis Group 1980–87: laminates, asymmetry, colourful abstract decoration
Sottsass, founder of Memphis; the Carlton bookcase

fit.risk: Pattern noise competes with data; can feel unserious for regulated or enterprise buyers.
